notes.title: v1.8 "The Mug" update
notes.notes:
Hi players!
First of all a big thank you for trying our game! We really enjoyed all the videos and reactions, we really enjoyed watching you play our game. We're really grateful for the exposure you provided and we want to say a special thanks to everybody who provided feedback! 

This update changes a few things.
- "The Mug" has been moved, it should now be easier to collect
- changed and hopefully clarified the last level
- added a room
- added/changed scares
- tweaked the rating values to (hopefully) be less punishing
- bugfixes

Here are some videos about the game we really enjoyed:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vqgeDw_z13c&t=232s
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=diH4n00_C5I

notes.title: Release on November 22nd!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! 

We're excited to announce the release of the game for the [b]22nd of November[/b], next Friday! 

Watching people play the demo was really fun and gave us a lot of valuable feedback. One of the videos we really enjoyed was uploaded by OKGray, a great and underappreciated channel on Youtube: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VP9-vaf-Q4Y&lc=UgzzR4QGUrMFALqwK1N4AaABAg.AArqga_TVZYAAsBMDovif8

We'd love your help to spread the word about this game, and we truly hope you enjoy it. Every bit of support helps us get closer to focusing on game development full-time, whether it's a video, a share, or even just adding it to your wishlist.

Thank you for your support!
